name: Switzerland
notes: Seed pass. Geography: 26 cantons (region, ISO 3166-2 codes, English names) and 2,110 municipalities (council tier, BFS numbers) from the BFS Historised Municipality Directory, snapshot 2026-10-01 (agvchapp.bfs.admin.ch); districts (Bezirke) are skipped because they are not general-purpose local government and several cantons have none. Boundaries: swisstopo swissBOUNDARIES3D 2026-01, free use under swisstopo's OGD terms with source reference (Bundesamt für Landestopografie swisstopo); the swiss-maps TopoJSON was not used because its BFS GEOSTAT data carries a non-commercial licence.

polls.scope: Swiss voters, Tamedia/20 Minuten post-vote survey (Nachabstimmungsbefragung)
polls.question: Federal wealth tax on large fortunes (the Green Liberal proposal: 0.33% above CHF 5 million, to fund the 13th AHV pension and the army)
